name: MIRAGE
description: MIRAGE is a benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation systems in the medical domain, comprising 7,663 questions from five medical QA datasets. It enables systematic assessment of different RAG configurations and backbone LLMs to improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations in medical question answering.
reputation: A recent medical RAG benchmark that is gaining attention in the research community, but it is not yet a widely established standard benchmark.
notes: First-of-its-kind benchmark for medical RAG systems; includes large-scale experiments and analysis of RAG components and scaling properties.
